verdict.rationale: Oneleet's Fieldwork lets a user describe a control, after which AI agents collect, validate, and package evidence across connected systems on a user-defined recurring schedule. That is a first-party, user-configured background automation, though it is limited to evidence collection and documented only on marketing pages. Built-in daily code scans and continuous monitors run autonomously but are fixed platform behaviors rather than user-set automations, and service keys for scripts are only developer building blocks. Missing for 10: a general-purpose automation builder beyond evidence collection, documentation of schedule configuration, triggers, and run controls, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: Describe your control. Fieldwork’s AI agents collect, validate, and package the evidence – across your enterprise systems, on your schedule.
